name: Roboflow Inference API
rate_limits: Free tier available with generous inference limits for hobbyist/student use. Self-hosted inference server is free with unlimited local processing. Cloud features consume credits.
notes: Computer vision inference platform with 50,000+ pre-trained models and datasets on Roboflow Universe. Supports object detection, classification, segmentation, and keypoint detection. Integrates foundation models: CLIP, Segment Anything, YOLO-World. Three deployment options: serverless hosted API, dedicated deployment, or self-hosted (free). Open-source inference server available on GitHub. Useful for AI self-improvement: visual understanding capabilities, pre-trained model access, dataset access for training, foundation model integration. Python SDK: inference_sdk.
